releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.7 - Gapless DJ Crossfade & Modern Delete Dialog
releaseNotes: Introduced true Gapless DJ Crossfade powered by an overlapping dual-deck ping-pong architecture with mathematical equal-power sine/cosine blending curves (0-12s configurable) and a modern rounded knob slider. Features redesigned Material 3 Expressive song deletion confirmation with track artwork preview cards and tactile haptic feedback.
